newsitem.title: USA: I/O Magic plans to acquire Eiger Labs.
newsitem.headline: I/O Magic plans to acquire Eiger Labs.

text.p: I/O Magic Corp, a maker of multimedia computer products, on Friday said it has signed a letter of intent to acquire Eiger Labs Inc, a producer of Portable PC card multimedia and communications products.

"The synergy of the two companies accelerates our push into the retail market," Tony Shahbaz, chief executive officer, said in a statement. "With the combination of a new management team, superior products and our cost efficient manufacturing capabilities, we will increase profit margins and rapidly grow and expand Eiger's product offerings."
The combined companies will operate in Irvine, Calif.
